No document found stating a specific construction-commencement year for this segment. What I found brackets it rather than pinning it: the 2020-11 amendment notice (JX_WB) still treats parts of the route as pre-construction ('十一...项目建成后...项目经验收合格后方可正式交付使用' language, and item 9 lists a 2018 siting approval as a still-relevant precondition) -- so construction had not fully started for the amended (Yudu-Ningdu) sub-leg as of Nov 2020; a 2021-05-16 provincial key-projects roster (sohu.com, https://www.sohu.com/a/466792472_661255, item 18 of the natural-gas list: 于都-宁都-广昌-南丰段) confirms this was an active, funded provincial project as of mid-2021; and the 2023-06-30 SSE bond disclosure (see Status record) shows the Yudu-Ningdu/Ningdu-Shicheng/Jinxian legs already built and operating by then. Construction most plausibly falls in the 2021-2022 window, but I did not find a document that states this directly (as opposed to inferring it from the gap between two other dates), so I am leaving this UNRESOLVED rather than fabricate a specific year.

No document states this segment (as GEM defines it -- the full Yudu-Ningdu-Guangchang-Nanfeng route, plus the bundled Ningdu-Shicheng spur) has entered service. The 2023-06-30 SSE bond disclosure names only the Yudu-Ningdu sub-leg, the Ningdu-Shicheng spur, and the (unrelated) Jinxian spur as 已建成并投产 by that date -- the Ningdu-Guangchang and Guangchang-Nanfeng portion, most of this segment's length, is not on that completed list, and the 2025-03 CCXI report still frames the whole Phase II programme as 在建 as of its most recent data (2024-03). Since the segment as a whole has not entered service, I am not staging a partial start date for just the Yudu-Ningdu sub-leg (that would misrepresent the row, which is Status=construction, not operating). See the __STATUS__ sentinel.
